ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ
ayahs.translit: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]

ayahs.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little

ayahs.arabic: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

ayahs.arabic: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلࣰ ا ثَقِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـࣰٔ ا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحࣰ ا طَوِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرࣰ ا جَمِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance

ayahs.arabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالࣰ ا وَجَحِيمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

ayahs.arabic: وَطَعَامࣰ ا ذَا غُصَّةࣲ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And food that chokes and a painful punishment

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبࣰ ا مَّهِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولࣰ ا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger

ayahs.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذࣰ ا وَبِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ayahs.translit: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired

ayahs.arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا
ayahs.translit: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way

ayahs.arabic: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ اۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرࣲ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرࣰ ا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرࣰ اۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمُۢ
ayahs.translit: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
